author: A. I. Mccann
title: Pasco County deputies search for missing teen Jailah Danella
text:
Chris Nocco, Pasco County Sheriff | https://www.pascosheriff.com/
Chris Nocco, Pasco County Sheriff | https://www.pascosheriff.com/
Pasco County Sheriff's Office is seeking the public's help in locating a missing 14-year-old, Jailah Danella. According to authorities, Danella was last seen on March 2 at approximately 9:55 p.m. in the Wesley Chapel Blvd. area of Wesley Chapel.
Danella is described as being 5 feet 6 inches tall and weighing about 100 pounds. She has black hair and brown eyes. At the time she went missing, she was wearing a black shirt, light-blue jeans, black socks, and green Crocs.
Anyone with information regarding Danella’s whereabouts is urged to contact the Pasco Sheriff’s Non-Emergency Line at 727-847-8102, option 7. Tips can also be submitted online through the sheriff's office website at http://PascoSheriff.com/tips.
